IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replay-safe command identifier. Reuse the same key, body and original precondition when retrying the same operation.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag of the target resource. For create-job/message/apply-result this is the project draft ETag.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF token from /me; server also validates Origin.

parameters.description: Schema-versioned validated metadata; arbitrary executable code is prohibited.

JobCreate.description: Freezes the draft matched by If-Match. Guided produce requires scriptApproved=true, valid scenes/evidence and a selected eligible voice. Automatic produce does not require script approval. Consent binds the returned version and selected provider terms; it is not permission for unbounded paid usage.

PublishCreate.description: Authorizes only this exact asset/job and current connection grant. Immediate needs a ready video; when_ready needs an automatic produce job. Scheduled can reference either, subject to its bounded lateness policy. Another deliberate submission can create another post; HTTP retries must reuse their idempotency key.
